title: Monsoon Preparedness Checklist
content: Residents are advised to check terrace drains, seal window gaps, and store emergency candles. Society will inspect common area drainage by 15th July.
author: Ramesh Kumar

title: Parking Slot Reallocation — Block A
content: Due to new EV charging bays, parking slots 12–18 in Block A basement will be renumbered. Affected residents will receive individual letters.
author: Ramesh Kumar
